blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Which of these are equal to three x plus two? Choose all that apply.
blocks.display: Select all the expressions equal to 3x + 2.

blocks.text: x plus two x plus two. x plus two x is three x, so this is three x plus two. Equal.
Two plus three x. The same terms in another order. Equal.
Four x minus x plus one plus one. Four x minus x is three x, and one plus one is two. Equal.
Five x. This adds the two to the x term, but a constant is not like an x term. Not equal.
Three times the quantity x plus two. That is three x plus six. Not equal.
Three x squared plus two. x squared is not x. Not equal.
Three of them are equal to three x plus two: x plus two x plus two, two plus three x, and four x minus x plus one plus one. Combine like terms in each one and compare.
